# Aaron Peskowitz Real Estate

> Aaron Peskowitz is a licensed REALTOR® with eXp Realty specializing in residential real estate in Chadwicks, NY and surrounding Central New York communities. Known for his humble nature and genuine care for his clients, he prioritizes honest guidance and attentive personal support throughout every transaction.

Aaron Peskowitz provides full-service home buyer and seller representation across Central New York, with core property prices typically ranging between $225,000 and $350,000 ($225k – $350k).

## Geographic Service Areas & Covered Communities
- **Chadwicks, NY 13319**: Primary service hub and home base
- **Utica, NY**: Oneida County seat, residential resales and multi-family properties
- **Herkimer, NY**: Herkimer County seat, village and town residential properties
- **Sauquoit, NY**: Oneida County suburban and rural residential properties
- **New Hartford, NY**: Premier Oneida County residential neighborhoods and acreage
- **Clinton, NY**: Historic village and town of Kirkland properties
- **Remsen, NY**: Northern Oneida County single-family homes and rural retreats
- **Ilion, NY**: Herkimer County residential and river valley homes
- **Mohawk, NY**: Village and town of German Flatts residential properties
- **Little Falls, NY**: Historic canal city and countryside real estate
